design: Connections / Context / Shared access. Full-page sharing-first connection view: choose a person, select documents in a searchable picker, then review an invitation. Conversation is a secondary Slack-style tab.
previewAccess: Conductor viewer sign-in required; disposable sample account/context

routing.scope: Historical focused route/API run, also covered by the final full UI suite.

conversations.layout: Secondary Conversation tab within the full-page Connections view. Desktop keeps the connection rail visible; mobile switches between list and selected person.
conversations.messageGrouping: Consecutive same-sender and same-author-kind messages on the same date within five minutes. Every original message ID, text, timestamp and receipt remains separately rendered.
